Procedural Harmonic Flow Grain Physics

Inspect the high-resolution timber grain: multi-harmonic periodic sine waves sampled at 1/32" precision, 4 concentric degradation rings on knots (#4a3018 to #785030), organic Gaussian streamline deflection around knots, and top 3/16" sunlit specular sheen (#f0c090 at 7% opacity).

2×6 Horizontal Board Tile (24" Repeat) Primary + Secondary Knots

Notice how the wood grain flows around the knot at X=8" rather than passing through it, and note the sunlit specular sheen band at the very top edge.

2×4 Center Trim Vertical Flow Vertical Stiffener

Rotated 90° procedural grain orientation preserving vertical wood grain physics for upright dimensional stiffeners.

⚖️ Canonical Rules Enforced Across All Assets
  • 1. Shell Law Outer black shells (#000000) are the true physical timber bounds. Inner wood fills inset exactly 0.1875" (3/16"). Zero SVG strokes.
  • 2. Overlap Law Horizontal boards extend 0.1875" into post shells on each side to guarantee seamless 2-pass fusion without white rendering hairline gaps.
  • 3. Color Chemistry Si View street terracotta cedar (#c88254) and warm sienna PT (#6c4834). Olive green (#7a855c) completely eliminated.
